title: Kloosterman multiplicities of the cut-open torus and the collapse at powers of two
claim: For the cut-open torus walk at n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, over GF(2), with K(a) = sum over x in GF(q) of (-1)^Tr(x + a/x) (1/0 = 0) and A_cone, C_s, T_h, eps as in CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001A and RETURN-DIGITS-20261109-001A: (1) K(a) = 0 mod 4 and sum over a in GF(q)* of K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 = q(q - 2)/8 = n(n - 1)/2, so if every a in GF(q)* is a root of det(I - mu A_cone) of order at least K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8, every eigenvalue of A is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity, A_cone is invertible and each order is exactly K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8; (2) ker(I + C_s(a)) is isomorphic to the space of F in F[k]/(k^h) with (k + 1) F(k + 1) = Omega_b(k) F(k) mod k^h, b = sqrt(a), Omega_b(k) = b eps(b^-4 k) = b + sum over i = 2..m of b^(2^i) k^(h - 2^(i-2)); (3) for b in GF(q), k^h Omega_b(k) = b^2 + k^(2h) L(b^4/k) as Laurent polynomials, L(x) = sum over i = 0..m of x^(2^i), so Omega_b(y) = y^h Tr(b^4/y) + b^2/y^h on GF(q)*; (4) the curve r + 1/r = t + 1/t + c of the substitution K -> K + c is birational to Y^2 + Y = x + c^-4/x, with q - 2 + K(c^-4) points with x != 0 over GF(q). Computed exactly (the Kloosterman law): the eigenvalue 1/a of A_cone has algebraic multiplicity K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 (= (t^2 - 1)/8, t = 1 - K(a) the trace of y^2 + xy = x^3 + a) and Jordan blocks 1, 5, 9, ... (K > 0) or 3, 7, 11, ... (K < 0) for every class at sides 4 to 128, and geometric multiplicity |K(a)|/4 for every a at sides 4 to 512 (stress run 256 and 512); the law's period exponent equals the computed one at 4 to 128; at sides 3 to 20 other than powers of two the cone has an irreducible factor of degree not dividing ord_(2n-1)(2). The target registered with this ticket, the law's lower bounds and with them the collapse at every power of two, is not proved.
failure_conditions: A power of two and an a in GF(2n)* at which the kernel of I + C_s(a) has dimension other than |K(a)|/4 (computed false at 4 to 64; side 128 is a planned check after registration).
A power of two and an a in GF(2n)* at which the multiplicity of the eigenvalue 1/a of A_cone differs from K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 (computed false at 4 to 128).
A power of two with an eigenvalue of A_cone outside GF(2n) (computed false at 4 to 128 by CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).
